label: Bible Study
prompt: Then Gideon built an _____ there unto the LORD, and called it Jehovah-shalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
verse: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the LORD, and called it Jehovah-shalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
note: Gideon's altar, named Jehovah-shalom — 'the LORD is peace' — built while Midianites still ruled the land.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all _____ from their eyes.
verse: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.
note: The Lamb becomes the Shepherd, leading to living waters and wiping away all tears.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there _____ round about him a light from heaven:
verse: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:
note: On the Damascus road a light from heaven 'shined' round about Saul — the KJV doesn't say shone.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work _____, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?
verse: And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?
note: Enemies kept inviting Nehemiah to a 'meeting'; he kept replying he was too busy with a great work.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the _____ of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.
verse: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.
note: Paul's shorter armour list: the 'breastplate of faith and love,' and the hope of salvation for a helmet.
